svg.text: 18 pt = 24 px. Thin arrows: instantiation. Thick arrows: traced functional ports. Dashed blocks: external library.
Functional port connections (same instances repeated for routing clarity)
Request and issue paths use parent muxes: head/linear addresses select u_parameters; QK selects u_cache;
head_math_issue / attention_math_issue select u_math.start and parent operand capture.
attention_div_start selects u_div.start and numerator/denominator. See port-map manifest and functional overview.
llm_soc: Host frontend and autonomous graph; parent muxes, operand caches, scaling, softmax/V pass,
reset_release: Asynchronous reset assertion; internal release after two rising edges. clk/rst_n ->
logic_mul: Combinational bit products and carry-save reduction; a/b -> product. No runtime multiply
Role: Low unsigned byte of scalar_b_q multiplied by signed scalar_a_q.
Parameters: A_W=39, B_W=8, OUT_W=48, SIGNED_A=1, SIGNED_B=0
Role: Middle unsigned byte of scalar_b_q multiplied by signed scalar_a_q.
Parameters: A_W=39, B_W=8, OUT_W=48, SIGNED_A=1, SIGNED_B=0
Role: High signed nine-bit part of scalar_b_q multiplied by signed scalar_a_q.
Parameters: A_W=39, B_W=9, OUT_W=48, SIGNED_A=1, SIGNED_B=1
Role: Softmax endpoint delta times twelve-bit interpolation fraction.
Parameters: A_W=25, B_W=12, OUT_W=37, SIGNED_A=0, SIGNED_B=0
Role: Signed Gumbel lookup value times unsigned temperature_q.
Parameters: A_W=24, B_W=8, OUT_W=33, SIGNED_A=1, SIGNED_B=0
llm_gumbel_sample: Combinational Gumbel table: index U8 -> signed value S24.
Role: Gumbel lookup indexed by random_q[31:24].
llm_exp_sample: Combinational exp table: index U9 -> value U25; default zero outside the table.
Role: Exp lookup at the selected interval index.
Role: Exp lookup at the adjacent index plus one.
llm_parameter_ram: Eight 32-bit lanes; compute row read / valid, host lane read and post-commit write
Role: Parameter image: 24576 x 256 bits; host accesses 32-bit lanes, compute reads complete rows.
llm_bank_ram: Thirty-two S24 banks; rd_en/rd_addr -> rd_data/rd_valid; masked writes and wr_busy
Role: Intermediate vector workspace: 96 x 768 bits; v_address_q/v_data/v_valid and masked
Parameters: LANES=32, WIDTH=24, ROWS=96, ADDR_W=7, USE_QUARTUS_MEMORY=1
Role: Causal K/V storage: 4096 x 768 bits; attention or parent k_read_address, k_data/k_valid and
Parameters: LANES=32, WIDTH=24, ROWS=4096, ADDR_W=12, USE_QUARTUS_MEMORY=1
llm_math: STREAMING=1, 32 S24xS32 lanes; accept E0, product_valid E3, sum_valid E8, legacy done E9.
llm_head_engine: Four ordered int8 chunks per row; parameter requests and parent math issue;
llm_attention_engine: Causal K reads and parent math issue; rounded/scaled QK scores, score array,
llm_linear_engine: Two-word parameter prefetch, ternary dot issue, S39 accumulation; start/ready,
isqrt_u64: 32-step unsigned floor square root: start/radicand -> busy/done/root.
Role: Parent RMS coefficient square root from root_input_q; root_busy/root_done/root return to
llm_attention_normalize: Eight four-lane batches; lane zero shared at top, three private dividers;
div: Unsigned restoring shift/subtract divider: start/numerator/denominator ->
Role: Shared U64/U32 divider: parent RMS reciprocal or attention-normalizer lane zero via
sigmoid: start/x_raw/frac_bits -> y_raw/busy/done; one table lookup and registered interpolation.
PERF_COUNTERS=0 and ENABLE_DEBUG_INDEX=0. Other configurations require a separate expansion.
USE_SHARED=1: normalizer lane zero is connected to top u_div; only lanes 1, 2, 3 are children.
Packages are source context, not instances. Generate scopes are annotations, not modules.
Alternate memory hierarchy: see rtl_hierarchy_portable.drawio. Quartus is a demonstration backend.
